description: Before paying an agent-payable API (x402 or MPP), check whether it is safe: does it answer reliably, do its payment terms match its listing (no switched or burn wallets, no overcharges), and is the address it asks you to pay one the seller has proven is theirs. Returns verdict ok | caution | avoid | unknown with reasons. Pass the payTo address from the 402 response when you have it.

payTo.description: Optional: the address its 402 response asks you to pay

url.description: The full https:// URL you are about to pay

name: check_payment
title: Check before paying an x402 / MPP endpoint
